# Arda Akgül

> Economics and business student at TED University. Research and writing on trade, sustainability, energy policy, and technology.

This is a public, read-only website. No account, registration, API key, MCP connection, or agent protocol is required to read its content. The files below are navigation aids, not a guarantee of search ranking or AI citations.

## Profile and work

- [About](https://arda-akgul.com/about/index.md): biography, education, and research interests.
- [Publications](https://arda-akgul.com/publications/index.md): publication record, credits, dates, and source links.
- [Experience](https://arda-akgul.com/experience/index.md): research, institutional roles, and media work.
- [Projects](https://arda-akgul.com/projects/index.md): case studies and links to working projects.
- [CV](https://arda-akgul.com/cv/index.md): concise biography and selected experience.
- [Contact](https://arda-akgul.com/contact/index.md): contact details.

## Personal interests

- [Music](https://arda-akgul.com/music/index.md): my selection of jazz, classical and early music, and lo-fi pieces.

## Project portfolios

- [RadioTEDU](https://arda-akgul.com/projects/radiotedu/index.md): projects I created and developed, with the mobile contribution listed separately.
- [Monarch Castle & SDCofA](https://arda-akgul.com/projects/monarch-castle/index.md): the complete project portfolio, linked to the individual applications.
- [Beyond Epicenters](https://arda-akgul.com/projects/beyond-epicenters/index.md): my research assistant role.
- [sTAM Sustainability Agenda](https://arda-akgul.com/projects/sustainability-agenda/index.md): my co-editor role.

## Writing

- [Writing archive](https://arda-akgul.com/blogs/index.md): essays and notes in English and Turkish.
- [Guides](https://arda-akgul.com/guides/index.md): practical notes on sustainability, preparedness, and analysis.
- [Publication Essays](https://arda-akgul.com/publications/): essays published on this website, listed separately from external publication records.
- [I Have Always Been Interested in Surveillance](https://arda-akgul.com/publications/why-i-stopped-fighting-the-cameras/): an essay on urban sensors and public outcomes.
